title: (Pwn2Own) Oracle Autonomous AI Database APEX Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass security checks on affected installations of Oracle Autonomous AI Database. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the gen_popup_list endpoint. The issue results from improper input validation. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of the oracle service account.
addtionnal_details:
Oracle has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at:
https://www.oracle.com/security-alerts/cspunov2026.html
timeline:
2026-10-26 - Vulnerability reported to vendor
2026-11-24 - Coordinated public release of advisory
